title: The league's biggest form movers, up and down
headline_insight: Victor Wembanyama is the league's biggest form riser: his 10-game rolling per-36 box composite climbed +19.821 over the observed span, ending at 37.869 -- the 100th league percentile.
what_it_means: This tracks each player's trajectory as a 10-game minute-weighted per-36 box composite, then measures the net change from first retained window to last. Wembanyama's box production roughly doubled from 18.048 to 37.869; the league median band sits at 13.754, which is how far above the middle his finish is. The mirror image is Myles Turner, the biggest faller at -11.043.
how_to_read: Each mover shows first_form and last_form (window box-composite values) and the delta between them; last_form_league_pctile places the ending level against the whole league.
why_it_matters: It surfaces who is trending sharply in either direction over multiple seasons -- a trajectory read, not a live hot-streak call.
caveat: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY -- box-composite only (NOT BPM/EPM/RAPM/DARKO), NOT age/opponent/role adjusted, and NOT player_id-deduped (accented names can split across ids). Delta is a net change over the whole span, not a current streak.
as_of: unknown (artifact carries no as_of field); seasons pooled 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26
